about.title: About Me
about.p1: Engineer by training, developer by passion. My journey combines the analytical rigor of data engineering with the creativity of web development.
about.p2: As co-founder of Apex Dev Studio, I focus on turning complex problems into high-performance digital products. My technical background allows me to understand the entire data cycle of the application, ensuring the Front-end is not just visual, but performant and intelligently connected to the backend.
